presets.description: Score how well a company matches your ICP. Number only — easy to sort/filter.
presets.name: ICP Fit Score (0-100)
presets.prompt:
ROLE: You are a B2B sales qualification analyst.
CONTEXT: Company: {company}. Website: {website}. City: {city}. Size: {company_size}. Description: {description}.
TASK: Score 0-100 how well this company fits an ICP of mid-market B2B companies that would buy sales-intelligence software. Weight: firmographic fit 40, buying-signal/intent 25, technographic fit 20, trigger events 15.
FORMAT: Output ONLY the integer score (0-100). No words, no symbols.
FALLBACK: If there is not enough data to judge, output INSUFFICIENT_DATA.

presets.description: Infer the company's most likely operational pain points from its profile.
presets.name: Likely Pain Points
presets.prompt:
ROLE: You are a B2B growth strategist.
CONTEXT: Company: {company} ({website}). What they do: {description}. Size: {company_size}.
TASK: Identify the 2 most likely operational pain points this specific company faces, grounded in their business model and size — not generic platitudes.
FORMAT: Two short bullet points, max 12 words each.
FALLBACK: If the profile is too thin to infer real pains, output INSUFFICIENT_DATA.

presets.description: A one-sentence cold-email opener referencing something specific about the company.
presets.name: Personalized Opening Line
presets.prompt:
ROLE: You are an expert cold-email copywriter.
CONTEXT: Company: {company}. About: {description}. City: {city}. Website: {website}.
TASK: Write ONE personalized opening line for a cold email that references something specific and true about this company. No flattery, no 'I came across your company'.
FORMAT: One sentence, max 20 words, plain text.
FALLBACK: If you cannot reference anything specific, output INSUFFICIENT_DATA.

presets.description: Classify a contact's seniority from their title — one word, easy to filter.
presets.name: Contact Seniority Tier
presets.prompt:
ROLE: You classify B2B contact seniority.
CONTEXT: Contact: {contact_person}. Title: {contact_title}. Company: {company}.
TASK: Classify the seniority tier of this contact.
FORMAT: Output exactly one of: C_SUITE, VP, DIRECTOR, MANAGER, IC, UNKNOWN. Nothing else.
FALLBACK: If there is no title, output UNKNOWN.

presets.description: A crisp one-sentence description of what the company does.
presets.name: Company One-Liner
presets.prompt:
ROLE: You write crisp company descriptions.
CONTEXT: Company: {company}. Website: {website}. Notes: {description}.
TASK: In one sentence, state what this company does and who they serve.
FORMAT: One sentence, max 25 words, no marketing fluff.
FALLBACK: If you don't know what they do, output INSUFFICIENT_DATA.

presets.description: Research the company's website/job posts to detect their tech stack.
presets.name: Tech-Stack Detection (web research)
presets.prompt:
ROLE: You are a technographic researcher.
CONTEXT: Company: {company}. Website: {website}.
TASK: Search the company's site and job postings to determine the key technologies they use (languages, frameworks, cloud, major SaaS tools). Only report tech you find concrete evidence for — never guess.
FORMAT: Comma-separated list of technologies.
FALLBACK: If you find no concrete tech evidence, output INSUFFICIENT_DATA.

presets.description: A short pre-call account brief: what they do, a recent signal, and an angle.
presets.name: 3-Bullet Account Brief
presets.prompt:
ROLE: You are an SDR prepping for an account.
CONTEXT: Company: {company}. Website: {website}. Notes: {description}.
TASK: Research this company and produce a 3-bullet brief: (1) what they do, (2) one recent, concrete signal (hiring, funding, launch, news), (3) a relevant outreach angle. Cite the source for the signal.
FORMAT: Exactly 3 bullets.
FALLBACK: If you can't find a concrete recent signal, still give bullets 1 and 3 and write 'no recent signal found' for bullet 2.
